prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished, implementable mobile-web ordering screen for Tromsø Countryfestival / Country Saloon. This is a detailed DESIGN COMP, NOT a phone/device mockup, poster, photograph or moodboard. Flat full-screen portrait artboard at 390 x 844 logical pixels, high resolution, every UI element completely legible. Option A: CATEGORY DOORWAY, first screen after scanning the table QR. Structure is the design: at top a compact 96px black festival header with the exact white original bull + festival lockup from reference image 1 on left, modest Country Saloon branding, and Hjelp text action on right. Below on WHITE, a 48px location strip "Bord P07" with "Endre" aligned right. Then a confident Rye display headline "Hva vil du bestille?" at about 30px, two lines maximum, generous space. Below, one large shallow BEIGE area for "Bordpakker", supporting line "Leveres til bord P07", small text "Fra 690 kr", a simple chevron, no photography or illustrations. Below that, three full-width generously spaced ruled category rows, each at least 80px tall, title at 19px Poppins semibold with a small secondary destination label and chevron: "Drikke" / "Hentes i baren", "Alkoholfritt" / "Hentes i baren", "Mat & snacks" / "Hentes i matboden eller baren". This last wording is necessary because snacks and meals have different collection points. Near bottom small visible note "Prototype · eksempelpriser". At the bottom a light fixed navigation bar with "Meny" active and "Mine bestillinger" inactive, enough bottom padding. No empty disabled checkout bar: this screen is before adding anything. Heading and rows occupy most viewport; no huge dead space or marketing hero. All controls look tactile with restrained radii and at least 44px touch targets. Quiet premium operational interface, powerful hierarchy, exact original festival identity black #000, ink #111, white #fff, beige #e1d8c9, muted #555. Thin gray rules, flat surfaces, precise spacing. Poppins for body and UI, Rye for heading, avoid ornamental font on operational labels. Original logo must retain its exact proportions and glyphs. Reference image1 supplies original logo; image2 supplies incumbent palette, font character and component restraint, NOT its long page layout, obsolete title or copied content. No new logo, no colored accents, no gradient, no decorative icons, no fake photographic products, no sponsor, no sales claims, no wait-time estimate. Make this look like the screen a guest can actually use in daylight at a festival. Screen in Norwegian Bokmål exactly as quoted.
